facts.fact: Lucan 已注意到 Micah 的隔街注视，起初觉得古怪。
facts.anchor: The veterinarian across the street won’t stop staring at me.

facts.fact: Micah 主动来到铁匠铺，二人首次交谈。
facts.anchor: I pull it open to find the veterinarian standing on my doorstep.

facts.fact: Micah 想为幼龙制作义翅。
Lucan 具体考虑重量、耐久与柔软度。
facts.anchor: “The prosthetics will have to be lightweight enough for her to carry, durable enough to survive daily use, and flexible enough not to rub her scales raw.”

facts.fact: Lucan 答应制作可测试的首个样件。
facts.anchor: “I’ll bring you the first prototype once I have something worth testing.”

facts.fact: 次日 Lucan 已完成初步草图。
facts.anchor: The wing design is a tangle of harsh lines

facts.fact: Lucan 带咖啡去诊所，并向 Micah 展示图纸。
facts.anchor: I awkwardly slide one of the cups across the desk.

facts.fact: Micah 对图纸的意义作出回应。
facts.anchor: “You’re giving Maple a chance to fly.”
